result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock, and the full suite passes (608 tests, offline). I didn't commit.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`listStockLevelsInWarehouse`, ~line 1491): added `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the per-category and slow-moving overviews use. Quantity lookups are unchanged, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock`, which takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" and the nut quantity is 0.

I left `getProductsBelow` alone on purpose: it is meant to include unstocked products, and its existing test asserts that.
